entries.mechanism: Michigan applies the same flat 4.25 per cent rate (MCL 206.51(1)) in both years, so the gap is entirely the rate on the 2024-to-2026 growth in the section 206.30 personal exemption (5,600 to 5,950 per person): 0.0425 * (5,950 - 5,600) = 14.875 per exemption, 1 exemption(s) for the single 30,000-dollar filer. The 2026 pipeline reports 1022.125 and TAXSIM 2024 reports 1037.0, a -14.88-dollar gap — the exemption indexation vintage, not a pipeline defect.
